title: Check obligations as well as prohibitions
statement: Check what an output must contain as well as what it must avoid, so an empty or minimal output that breaks no rule still fails.
detail: The pedagogy decision-bank experiment design requires both positive obligations and prohibitions, so an empty or minimal artifact fails completeness even if it avoids every violation. Its headline metric counts only held-out tasks that produce a complete artifact satisfying every active critical rule, which keeps an output from passing by doing nothing.
